title: Melting Unicorn on Crescent Moon
description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a blue melting unicorn with yellow eyes and icicle-like drips sitting on a large glowing crescent moon. The unicorn holds a gnarled staff while yellow and purple paint drips heavily downward onto a twisted, spiraling tree with swirling branches below.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene of a bright blue melting unicorn with large yellow eyes and dripping icicle texture, sitting on a glowing purple and white crescent moon against a gradient purple to orange sky. The unicorn holds a twisted organic staff. Heavy purple, blue, and yellow paint drips cascade down from the unicorn and moon onto a gnarled brown tree with spiral patterns in its branches. Small yellow dripping creatures float in the air. Psychedelic, vibrant, painterly style with visible brushwork and fluid drips.
